rules.statement: A court should not grant a declaration or order relief that goes beyond what has been prayed for in the pleadings.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) In the absence of a prayer for such relief the District Judge had acted in excess of jurisdiction in granting a declaration that the plaintiff was the tenant of the premises and in ordering the ejectment of the defendant and delivery of possession to the plaintiff. (2) The lease in favour of the plaintiff had come to an end on 31. 12. 1980 when he willingly surrendered possession of the premises to the new lessees from; 01. 01. 1981 enabling the owner to deal with the property as he wished.
